fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Reservoir Dynamics with Overtopping + Kaplan Turbine ODE
source: Kofoed (2002) PhD Thesis Aalborg; Kofoed et al. (2006) Coastal Eng. 53:859-867 (Wave Dragon prototype); Van der Meer & Janssen (1995) overtopping; TAW (2002) / EurOtop (2018) overtopping manual; Tedd & Kofoed (2009) Renew. Energy 34:711.

unit.name: Wave Dragon-class Overtopping WEC — Physics-Lumped Reservoir

ramp_width_m.note: Effective overtopping crest width (Wave Dragon w/ reflectors ~ 150 m)

A_reservoir_m2.note: Plan area of elevated reservoir (Wave Dragon ~ 5000-8000 m2)

crest_freeboard_m.note: Rc — ramp crest height (freeboard) above mean sea level; equals nominal reservoir head

reservoir_depth_max_m.note: Maximum reservoir water depth above crest before spillage (storage capacity)

n_turbines.note: Number of low-head Kaplan turbines (Wave Dragon multi-turbine array)

turbine_K_m2.note: Lumped turbine discharge coefficient: Q_turb = K*sqrt(2 g H) per the orifice/turbine flow law, sized so the full 16-turbine array passes the design overtopping inflow at the mid-reservoir operating head (self-regulating equilibrium ~0.5 m above crest at Hs=3 m)
turbine_K_m2.source: calibrated to Q_in=Q_out mass balance at design sea state

slope_alpha.note: Mean ramp/run-up slope angle (~ tan(alpha)=0.55, doubly-curved Wave Dragon ramp)

vdm_a.note: Van der Meer/EurOtop overtopping pre-factor a in q* = a*exp(-b*Rc*)

vdm_b.note: Van der Meer/EurOtop overtopping decay coefficient b (dimensionless freeboard)
